corrections.issue: Initial resource metric joined Stage09 runtime-state rows and therefore observed only fishing, the only activity with separately materialized runtime state at bootstrap.
corrections.fix: Resource/ecology metrics now consume the public Stage09 node projection, preserving all six activities and lazy-state semantics.

corrections.issue: Initial market metric sampled representative goods only at POI-002, making healthy workshop/warehouse stock look absent.
corrections.fix: Metric now selects the strongest valid stock node among Stage13 vendors while preserving each local market row.

corrections.issue: Replay test compared demand before the first causal application with demand after replay.
corrections.fix: Test now compares state immediately after first application against replay state; runtime idempotency rule was not weakened.

corrections.issue: Determinism test compared a mutated world against a fresh world with the same seed.
corrections.fix: Equivalent fresh baselines are compared; deterministic metrics/details pass.

corrections.issue: First causal bridge exposed infrastructure/resources/production/market/labor/ecology/security but population, factions and legal governance were only indirect.
corrections.fix: Added explicit population_welfare, faction_stability and governance_stability metrics with no-sovereignty/no-lawlessness guards.

corrections.issue: Persistence and some Country regressions can exceed the executor limit when chained after other expensive country bootstraps.
corrections.fix: Affected tests were executed in isolated processes; completed suites passed. Timeouts were not counted as PASS.
